relations.description: Transmission failure triggers abortion of security mode control procedure.
Security mode control procedure abortion leads to registration procedure initiation when triggered by registration.
Security mode control procedure is triggered by service request procedure.
TAI change condition affects security mode control procedure behavior.
TAI not in list condition leads to registration procedure initiation.
TAI in list condition allows UE to re-run service request procedure.
Security mode control procedure involves SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
Security mode control procedure involves SECURITY MODE REJECT message.
